summary:
Córdoba is a province of Argentina. Legal gender recognition, access to gender-affirming care and recognition of relationships that local law would class as same-sex are set by the national framework described in the Argentina record, and the sources reviewed here record no provincial statute or provincial administrative rule departing from it. Provincial machinery that would matter to a visitor or a resident — a provincial anti-discrimination statute, provincial hate-crime reporting, provincial health-plan coverage rules, provincial custodial arrangements — does not appear in the available sources.

The one Córdoba-specific enforcement fact in the inventory concerns a cluster of deaths. Between 18 and 26 November 2025, police forces in three Argentine provinces, Córdoba among them, intervened in the deaths of three LGBT+ people over eight days. The source does not disaggregate the cluster by province, by victim group, or by whether any of the deceased was transgender, and it does not state whether police involvement was investigative or otherwise. Three deaths across three provinces in eight days is a raw count with no population denominator; no per-capita rate can be derived from it, and it cannot be read as a measure of risk in Córdoba specifically.
tangentialFactors: The Córdoba signal sits inside a documented multi-province cluster rather than a Córdoba-only pattern. The November 2025 deaths were recorded across three provincial police jurisdictions, and the source gives no provincial breakdown, so Córdoba's own share of the three deaths is not established. Because the cluster is recorded under the aggregated LGBT+ category, the trans-specific dimension of any Córdoba case is not documented either.
localsOnly: No Córdoba-specific resident-facing provision appears in the available sources. Residents rely on the national framework for gender recognition, care and relationship recognition, and the inventory records no provincial statute, provincial agency or provincial programme operating in these areas. The one provincial institution named is the Córdoba police force, in connection with the November 2025 deaths cluster.
outOfScopeNotes: Unresolved: the source for the November 2025 cluster does not state how many of the three deaths occurred in Córdoba, whether any victim was transgender, or what form police involvement took. No provincial hate-crime count for Córdoba exists in the inventory; the national observatory total aggregates sexual orientation and gender identity and is not disaggregated by province or victim group, so Córdoba's share cannot be calculated and no per-capita comparison is possible. Whether Córdoba has a provincial gender-identity or anti-discrimination statute, or any provincial health or custodial rule supplementing the national framework, is not sourced here.
